summary: Ran requested backend + frontend regression for OperationCard V5 scope. Backend P0 regression passed fully and static V5 test passed, but live UI validation of V5 cards was blocked on preview due aborted browser API requests and missing rendered operation cards.

ui_bugs.issue: No rendered `operation-card-v5-main-*` cards found during authenticated UI runs, so required V5 field/toggle/menu/button behavior could not be validated live.

integration_issues.flow: Login -> /operations data loading in Playwright against public preview
integration_issues.issue: Multiple `/api/*` requests aborted at browser layer (`net::ERR_ABORTED`), including `/api/operations?limit=200`, blocking reliable card rendering verification in automation.

action_items: Investigate preview-edge/browser-layer aborts for authenticated `/api/*` requests during UI automation (likely ingress/challenge interference), then re-run V5 live card checks.

Ensure at least one non-destructive operation record is available/rendered in Operations page test environment so V5 card interactions can be validated end-to-end without creating financial side effects.
Re-run UI checks specifically for: required fields, additional/full details toggles, more-actions menu items, and confirm-collection button state wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/src/pages/Operations.jsx` is very large (~3850 lines), exceeding maintainability guidance (>700 lines) and increasing regression risk for UI behavior changes like OperationCard V5 integration.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (static V5 Jest + mobile overflow smoke passed; live V5 card interaction coverage blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials source read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and public URL from frontend/.env. Backend regression command passed: pytest -q /app/backend/tests/test_iter331_p0_unification_regression.py --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter334_iter331_backend.xml. Static frontend command passed: yarn test --watchAll=false --runInBand src/components/__tests__/operation-card-v5-static.test.js. Playwright observed repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` for preview API calls and no OperationCard V5 instances rendered.
rca of the issue: Root cause is not a proven OperationCard JSX defect. Reproduction in browser automation shows preview-layer request aborts (`/api/operations?limit=200` and other `/api/*`) causing unstable/empty runtime data state; therefore V5 card rendering/interaction cannot be conclusively validated live in this run.
